title: Valesong has launched!
author: Every-Chemistry-1726
selftext:
Hi there,

  
We just launched out new 4-player CCG Valesong on Discord as an activity. Please give it a try and let me know what you think. It was entirely vibecoded and I feel like it's very high quality but I want other people's opinions on the game. Just go to any discord server.. go to a text or voice channel. click on the activity icon towards the bottom next to your handle and search for Valesong and launch it. super easy. Discord server owners can install it right from their app directory if they want. The website is [https://www.valesong.com](https://www.valesong.com) if you want to find out more. I would greatly appreciate any help in spreading the word if you think the game is good!

  
Thanks

  
John Smedley - CEO, Distinct Possibility Studios
